doc.title: Jimmy Witherspoon interviewed by Monk Rowe, Sarasota, FL, April 12, 1996

title: Music heard growing up
summary: He recalls the bands played at home: Lunceford, Basie, Goodman, Shaw, Kirk, McShann, Ellington.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Growing up with radio, records and family listening

blocks.x: When you were growing up, was it mostly the radio that you heard at home?
Well I had no television then. When I grew up — I must divulge my age, now I’m 73. So you know when I was a kid there was no television.
What kind of music was going on in your home?
Jimmy Lunceford, Count Basie, Benny Goodman, Artie Shaw, Andy Kirk, Jay McShann. Those kind of people you know.
Some of those people who you later on in life became pretty familiar with.
Now from what I’ve read you had an interesting first experience in performing music halfway around the world?
